chunks: Whether you warn them or do not warn, it is all the same; they will not believe.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says it is the same whether you warn them or not?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the 'Kuffar' (disbelievers) who possess a sealed heart, distinguishing them from those who merely lack knowledge but remain open to guidance. It underscores the concept of 'Jahd al-Kufr' (intensity of disbelief), where the failure to believe is not due to the absence of the message but an intrinsic resistance to its truth, a theme central to the narrative of Prophet Muhammad's mission in Surah Yaseen. This highlights the divine wisdom in sending warnings even to those whose rejection is predetermined by their own spiritual state.
